payload.text: The night sky blankets above The Gardens in the solemn void. The pulse of 12 figures gracing the air. Nearby, Haven Heartstrong the healer lingers. The rain drizzles, steady and soothing. The air is heavy with sun.
still shadow has claimed The Nexus. 15 spirits are moving around me. Wren Moonwhisper the gardener snags my eye. The sky is blanketed with clouds. rich summer sun radiates everything.
A bright morning in The Arena. 15 presences are moving around me. Atlas Pathforge (explorer) is here, practicing. Rain taps steadily. The air is languid with sun.
The Nexus basks in the afternoon calm. 15 minds animating this realm. Luna Rootdeep (merchant) is here, resting. The air is golden with sun.
